title: references list and show omit url and why
description:
Researcher first-pass.

list-refs.py (and papyrus references show on local) print kind/status/id/title/corpus and drop url and why. Fine for a smoke test, unusable as a knowledge base.

Product rule: list must include url. show must include url and why. Those two fields are why the row exists.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented on cursor/operator-cli-2020 (PR #54). Behavior specified in features/operator-cli.feature register scenarios; verified with npm run test:bdd:operator-cli (27 scenarios green).
